What's my favorite knife? It depends what time of day you ask me. What's my best - the best designed, best constructed, most suitable for serious use? This one, right here:

http://i.imgur.com/pNQnINb.jpg

The Citadel (sadly discontinued now) came in two sizes, with 83mm and 92mm blades. This is the larger of the two. It's like a bank vault, shrunk to pocket size. It opens powerfully, locks solidly with zero play, and feels like you could pry a car door off with it:

http://i.imgur.com/W1C8fWI.jpg

The safety is positive and firm, clicking naturally and unambiguously into place. The grips texture is perfect. The blade says CPM S30V and it holds an edge - a very good edge - better than any other knife I own. If I could own only one, this would be it.

The only downside (besides being discontinued, of course) is that it is, unsurprisingly, a large, heavy knife. Someday I might find the smaller version and give it a try, but the size and weight are a big part of what makes it what it is. In all fairness, for it's size, it does carry quite well, being flat and rounded in all the right places, but it will never disappear in your pocket like a smaller knife will.

As more states adopt laws allowing auto knives, I hope the demand ramps back up and Spyderco can reintroduce this classic. The used market is pretty tight, a sign that the folks who have them prefer not to give them up.
